course_name_en: Alternative Propulsion Systems in Motor Vehicles
prerequisites: It is recommended to have taken the 'Engines' course.

learning_outcomes.text: Explains the general structure of internal combustion engines.
Explains the use of LPG in vehicles.
Explains the use of natural gas as an alternative energy source.
Can explain the use of biodiesel in vehicles.
Outlines the use of hydrogen energy and fuel cells in vehicles.

syllabus_topics: Alternative Propulsion Sources Used in Engines
Natural Gas Usage Technologies in Motor Vehicles
Use of Biodiesel in Engines and Comparison with Other Fuels
Use of Hydrogen as Fuel in Engines
assessment_rules: The overall assessment is divided into two main parts: in-term activities and the final exam. In-term activities contribute 50% to the overall grade, while the final exam contributes the remaining 50%. The in-term activities consist of a midterm exam (50%), Quiz 1 (20%), Assignment 1 (10%), and Quiz 2 (20%).
bibliography: Taymaz I., Motorlarda Yeni Taşıtlar Ders Notları, SAU, 2008
